rules: Buy at the next open; exit by the setup rule; closed results frozen.

changes.text: Washout exit: the tight stop (1 ATR under the signal-day low) was replaced by a 25% disaster stop. It stopped out most trades that went on to recover; tested on 3 years in all three markets, win rate rose from about 45% to 65% and the average result roughly doubled.
